The Presidential Communications Program is at the core of our mandate to serve as the primary communication arm of the Office of the President and the Executive Branch, ensuring that government messages are clear, consistent, and accessible to the Filipino people.

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000085

The program primarily focuses on the formulation, coordination, and implementation of integrated public information plans and programs that effectively communicate the priorities, policies, and achievements of the President and the Executive Department.

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000087

It involves not only the crafting of messages but also the careful alignment of communication strategies across agencies to ensure coherence and clarity in how government policies and programs are conveyed to the public.

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000088

In a time when information is fast-moving and often contested, the program ensures that our citizens receive timely, accurate, and relevant information straight from the government.

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000089

In line with this,

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000091

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000092

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000094

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000095

We also conduct regular press briefings to provide timely updates and clarification.

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez

asr-000096

Source

Secretary David M. Gomez
